roleContext.roleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform
roleContext.jobDescription: The customer service centre platform hosts the telephony, chat and case-management services for a retail bank's contact centres. The Cloud Resource Engineer manages the platform's cloud accounts, capacity and cost controls, responds to resource incidents during business hours and on the on-call rota, and works with the contact-centre operations team on change windows. The role requires calm, structured incident handling under pressure and clear stakeholder communication during outages.

requirements.text: Manages cloud accounts, quotas and tagging for the contact-centre platform and keeps the resource inventory current.
Handles resource incidents under pressure, including on the on-call rota, and communicates status to contact-centre operations during outages.
Runs monthly capacity and cost reviews and proposes right-sizing changes with documented impact.
Coordinates change windows with contact-centre operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents runbooks, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each platform change.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform

## Experience

- Managed the platform's three AWS accounts, quota requests and the tagging policy for the telephony and chat services, keeping the resource inventory current in the CMDB after each change window.
- Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.
- Wrote the post-incident review for the June outage, including the timeline, the missed capacity alarm and the follow-up actions, which the platform lead approved and the operations team accepted.
- Ran the monthly capacity and cost review with the platform lead, proposing right-sizing of the chat-service instances with the expected monthly saving and the rollback path documented in the change record.
- Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the June outage post-incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and the chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with the ticketing system's audit history as a verification trail.
